summary: Allarity Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting results of its June 26, 2026 annual meeting. Seven proposals were voted, including election of director Jesper Hoiland (3.75M for, 187k withheld), ratification of auditor Wolf Company P.C. (8.33M for), amendment to 2021 equity plan increasing authorized shares from 1,521,990 to 2,021,990 (3.08M for), advisory say-on-pay (3.62M for), approval of share issuance under a January 2026 common stock purchase agreement with Tumim Stone Capital LLC (3.17M for), a failed officer liability limitation amendment (3.52M for, below required majority), and approval of meeting adjournment (7.31M for). Also disclosed that June 30, 2026, the Nasdaq Staff determined the company regained compliance with the minimum bid price rule. The filing is a routine shareholder meeting report and a compliance update, not a special situation event requiring further analysis.
